info.title: TeleMed API
info.description: Telemedicine appointment booking API. All fields snake_case. Datetimes tz-aware ISO 8601 (UTC in responses). Money is a 2-decimal string. Rate limiting is out of scope (x-rate-limit: none). Narrative source: api-contracts.md. Admin access rule: ADMIN may GET any id-addressed resource (profiles, appointments, notes, doctors), edit patient profiles (AC-01), list/deactivate/reactivate users and onboard doctors. ADMIN may NOT book, cancel, reschedule, change status or add notes on behalf of others, and gets 403 on role-specific /me routes. Patient-profile edits are allowed only for the owning patient or an admin; a doctor or another patient is refused.

RegisterRequest.description: AC-01 registration. full_name, age, gender and phone are required; missing/invalid -> 422 with field-level errors[]. The initial profile is stored as patient_profile_versions version 1. Unknown fields (e.g. role) are ignored.

PatientProfileUpdate.description: Partial update: omitted fields carry forward from the current version. Required profile fields cannot be cleared (null is rejected with 422). At least one key must be present.

Gender.description: Patient gender. UNDISCLOSED = prefers not to say.

InvalidCredentials.description: 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS (identical body for every login failure)

Forbidden.description: 403 FORBIDDEN: authenticated but the role is not allowed on the route (includes ADMIN on patient/doctor-only actions and /me routes; doctor on patient-profile edit)

NotFound.description: 404 NOT_FOUND: missing or another user's object

Conflict.description: 409: SLOT_UNAVAILABLE, INVALID_APPOINTMENT_STATE, CHANGE_WINDOW_CLOSED, INVALID_SLOT_STATE, ACTIVE_APPOINTMENTS_EXIST, CANNOT_DEACTIVATE_SELF or EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED (see code)
